name: Moorland
desc: Exposure and long silences - miles of nothing, weather coming, no shelter in any direction.
tags: scenery, no humans, moorland, heather, rough grass tussocks, peat bog pools, dry stone wall, rolling low hills, gorse, no trees, grey overcast sky, distant rain
prose: open moorland of heather and rough tussock grass rolling away over low hills, dark peat pools and a broken dry stone wall crossing it, under a heavy grey overcast with rain falling somewhere in the distance
note: The model has no strong idea of moor and will hand back a green meadow or an alpine pasture with trees on it - heather and an explicit no trees are the two tags doing the work. A dry stone wall or a single standing stone gives scale and stops it reading as empty texture. Keep the sky heavy; put a blue sky on this and it becomes the summer meadow card.
